The '''grazer''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the plains and in the valleys of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. It was preyed upon by packs of [[Feline/Legends|cat-like]] [[leaptig]]s.
